title: Parcel Carrier Delay League Table
dataSources: Consumable levels (`supply:level`), parcels (`delivery:parcel`), bin collections (`bincollection:event`), gift-card balances (`giftcard:balance`).
app: Household logistics feeds — smart-scale consumable trackers, parcel/delivery tracking APIs, council bin-collection calendars, and gift-card balance logs — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=delivery:parcel
| stats avg(delay_hours) as avg_delay, perc90(delay_hours) as p90_delay, count as parcels by carrier
| sort - avg_delay
description: Ranks the carriers that are most likely to miss promised delivery windows for your household.
value: A delay league table turns delivery frustration into evidence you can use when choosing shipping options.
implementation: Track delivery events with carrier and delay-hours fields in `index=personal`; compare average and p90 delay by carrier.
visualization: Carrier leaderboard of average and p90 parcel delays.
grandmaExplanation: It watches which delivery carriers keep making your parcels late, instead of every delay feeling like random bad luck.
